response.overview: Through the personal stories of residents uprooted from the Chavez Ravine, trace the human cost of Dodger Stadium and the echoes of displacement still felt in Los Angeles today. From the studio that brought you "How to be Seen" and "SKATE AT YOUR OWN RISK," ROAR Studios presents: "The Uprooted," a new documentary film from director Elena Conic.
response.tagline: The Human Cost of an Iconic Stadium
response.title: The Uprooted
